The scientist must possess a strong work ethic and an ability to quickly master numerous new techniques. [Company name masked] has a proud record of drug development for neurodegenerative diseases that has been driven by a highly collaborative and diverse team of accomplished scientists.

Perform all core in vivo dosing techniques as well as lab specific methods

Perform key lab techniques associated in vivo work (pipetting, sample/solution prep)

Exceptional communication skills for presenting data clearly to supervisors and project teams.
Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a team setting.
Proven expertise in CSF collection and ICV injections.

Deep knowledge of biochemical assays (ELISA/Westerns).
Advanced knowledge of neurodegenerative disorders.
Substantial drug development experience.
Strong documentation and presentation skills.

A key focus will be coordinating the use of multiple in vivo techniques, including complex surgical models, to support therapeutic investigations in pre-clinical animal models. The scientist will collaborate with colleagues across the Neurodegeneration group to facilitate both exploratory and portfolio workstreams. [Company name masked] has a proud record of drug development for neurodegenerative diseases, built through a highly collaborative and diverse team of accomplished scientists.

Strong skills and significant experience in developing/performing in vivo applications.
Accurate, timely record keeping and data collection with clear organization.
Clear communication of data with supervisor and project teams.
Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a team setting.
Prior experience in CSF collection and ICV injections.
Some experience with biochemical assays (ELISA/Westerns).
Knowledge in neurodegenerative disorders.
Drug development experience.
Strong documentation, communication, and presentation skills.

A key focus of the scientist will be the utilization of multiple in vivo techniques including complex surgical models to support therapeutic investigations in pre-clinical animal models. Importantly, the individual will collaborate with colleagues across the Neurodegeneration group to facilitate both exploratory and portfolio workstreams. The scientist must possess a strong work ethic and an ability to quickly master numerous new techniques. [Company name masked] has a proud record of drug development for neurodegenerative diseases that has been driven by a highly collaborative and diverse team of accomplished scientists. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with in vivo techniques and pre-clinical research.
cond_0644.responsibilities:
Lead and conduct in vivo studies from start to finish, including all sample collection
Perform all core in vivo dosing techniques as well as lab specific methods
Master and perform rodent surgical techniques
Perform key lab techniques associated in vivo work (pipetting, sample/solution prep)
cond_0644.requirements:
BS/MS in Biology, Animal Sciences, Pharmacology, or a related field with 1+ years of post-degree relevant academic or industry work experience.
Strong skills and significant experience in developing/ performing in vivo applications.
Accurate, timely record keeping and data collection with clear organization.
Clear communication of data with supervisor and project teams.
Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a team setting.
Prior experience in CSF collection and ICV injections
Some experience with biochemical assays (ELISA/Westerns)
Knowledge in neurodegenerative disorders
Drug development experience.
Strong documentation, communication, and presentation skills
